cues.text: Place new order: type the PLUs, one per line, then choose the delivery: Home Delivery, Express.
Place test order, check the summary and confirm: the run starts on the server.
It runs by itself, in about 4 minutes (sped up here): the steps tick off, and Live browser shows the shop.
Then it approves the order in the backoffice, with your backoffice account…
…and waits until the order is ORDER_EXTRACTED: the run is Completed, with its order number.
Every run is kept in Logs / History with its screenshots: yours and your colleagues’.
